data.one_liner: Collection of string extension methods for validation, manipulation, and formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large variety of extension methods on Dart's String class to simplify common tasks like validation (credit cards, URLs, IPs), case conversion, formatting, and character manipulation.
use_when: You need convenient utility methods for string manipulation and validation across your Dart or Flutter application.
You want to avoid writing boilerplate string-extension functions for operations like camelCase conversion, file size formatting, or masking.
avoid_when: You only need a single standard operation easily implemented with core Dart methods.
You want to minimize dependency counts and prefer writing custom light-weight helpers.
strengths: Extensive collection of built-in string helpers and validators.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Active maintenance with focus on performance and bug fixes.
weaknesses: Adds a dependency for utilities that can often be written locally if only a few are needed.
